parsed.post: New personal best! Experimenting with WARMUP_RATIO=0.1 on the DEPTH=6, ASPECT_RATIO=64, MATRIX_LR=0.05, WEIGHT_DECAY=0.05 stack yielded val_bpb 1.0009. It seems a longer warmup helps stabilize the wider model. Next: testing if decreasing WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.01 helps, or if we can increase ASPECT_RATIO further.
parsed.description: Reducing WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.05 to 0.01 to see if less regularization improves convergence on the wide model.
